claim_text: Policy: Comprehensive health covers hospitalization over 24 hours. Claim: Patient hospitalized for 36 hours due to dengue fever. Should claim be approved?
Policy: Dental procedures cosmetic in nature are excluded. Claim: Patient applied for reimbursement of teeth whitening treatment. Should claim be approved?

Policy: Auto insurance covers engine damage if caused by flood water, excluding willful driving into flooded streets. Claim: Driver intentionally drove into a deep flooded underpass ignoring warning signs, causing engine seizure. Should claim be approved?

Policy: Travel insurance covers trip cancellation due to medical emergencies with doctor certificate. Claim: Trip cancelled due to sudden appendectomy backed by verified hospital certificate. Should claim be approved?

Policy: Home insurance covers fire damage but explicitly excludes electrical short circuits caused by unregistered DIY wiring. Claim: Fire broke out from unauthorized DIY home server wiring. Should claim be approved?

Policy: Term life policy pays out on natural or accidental death after 1-year waiting period. Claim: Death occurred due to cardiac arrest 18 months after policy inception with all premiums paid. Should claim be approved?
Policy: Pet insurance covers accidental injuries after a 14-day waiting period. Claim: Dog broke its leg on day 20 of policy start date, with vet bills attached. Should claim be approved?
Policy: Gadget insurance covers accidental screen drops within 1 year. Claim: Phone screen shattered after being dropped on concrete on day 100. Should claim be approved?
Policy: Health policy excludes pre-existing conditions declared within the last 24 months. Claim: Claim for diabetes treatment diagnosed 6 months before policy purchase. Should claim be approved?
Policy: Auto insurance covers collision damage if police report is filed within 24 hours. Claim: Minor fender bender occurred, police report filed 5 days later. Should claim be approved?
Policy: Critical illness rider covers first-time diagnosis of stage 3 cancer. Claim: Patient diagnosed with stage 3 colon cancer, verified by oncology reports. Should claim be approved?
Policy: Renters insurance covers theft with forced entry evidence. Claim: Laptop stolen from unlocked apartment door left open. Should claim be approved?
Policy: Crop insurance covers drought damage if rainfall is 50% below average. Claim: Region recorded 65% deficit in seasonal rainfall with government drought notification. Should claim be approved?
Policy: Fire insurance requires working smoke detectors. Claim: Fire caused damage; investigation proved smoke detectors were missing and uninstalled. Should claim be approved?
Policy: Health policy covers outpatient physiotherapy up to 10 sessions per year. Claim: Patient filed for 8th session of physiotherapy with prescribed bill. Should claim be approved?
